<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>MouseTrainer.Simulation</id>
    <version>1.1.4</version>
    <authors>mcp-tool-shop</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/MouseTrainer</projectUrl>
    <description>Deterministic 60Hz fixed-timestep game simulation engine with accumulator-based loop, composable blueprint mutators, replay recording and verification, and session management. Platform-stable reproducibility via xorshift32 RNG.</description>
    <copyright>Copyright (c) 2025-2026 MCP Tool Shop</copyright>
    <tags>deterministic simulation game-loop fixed-timestep replay mutators</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/MouseTrainer" commit="c1d33027439f5f3cfd597525143ea32b9491046d" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="MouseTrainer.Domain" version="1.1.4" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
